Wegmans responds to cost concern with T-giving meal

The grocer’s latest survey shows 72% are worried about the price of food

Supermarket News Staff

October 20, 2026

2 Min Read
To help customers serve a complete holiday meal without overspending, Wegmans’ Thanksgiving meal includes all the essentials for a traditional Thanksgiving dinner.Shutterstock
Want a quick summary?
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:57
Instaread

Wegmans is among the latest grocers announcing a Thanksgiving meal deal as store insiders express concern about the cost of food.

According to a recent survey of Wegmans Insiders, the cost of Thanksgiving remains a concern for many shoppers this year. Among customers planning to host, 87% say they are concerned about the cost of food and ingredients. At the same time, 72% say high quality is more important than finding the lowest price, highlighting that customers are focused on getting the best quality and value for their money.

To help customers serve a complete holiday meal without overspending, Wegmans’ Thanksgiving meal includes all the essentials for a traditional Thanksgiving dinner for eight people for less than $5 per person, matching the cost of last year’s meal:

  • Shady Brook Farms Frozen Turkey, 13 pounds

  • McCormick Brown Gravy Mix, 2 count

  • Stove Top Stuffing Mix Twin Pack, 12 ounces.

  • Wegmans Yellow Onions, 2-pound bag

  • Jiffy Corn Muffin Mix, 2 count

  • Wegmans Chicken Stock, 1 count

  • Wegmans Dinner Rolls, 1 count

  • Wegmans Canned Corn, 2 count

  • Wegmans Jellied Cranberry Sauce, 1 count

  • Wegmans Cut Green Beans, 2 count

  • Wegmans French Fried Onions, 1 count

  • Wegmans Cream of Mushroom Soup, 2 count

  • Wegmans Russet Potatoes, 5-pound bag

  • Yams, 3 pounds

  • Wegmans Macaroni & Cheese, 2 count

  • Sara Lee Frozen Pumpkin Pie, 1 count

Related:Aldi, Sam’s Club and others offer T-giving meals

Thanksgiving promotions are available Nov. 8 through Nov. 28, while frozen turkey promotions are available Nov. 8 through Nov. 22.

“Thanksgiving is about gathering with family and friends around a meal that feels special and familiar,” said Tom Way, Wegmans senior vice president of merchandising. “Our customers want to make their holiday budgets go further without compromising on quality.”

Many of the Thanksgiving essentials included in the meal are part of Wegmans’ Hot Zone pricing program, making it easier for customers to find values throughout the store.

Aldi, Lidl, Sam’s Club, Giant Eagle and Schnucks all announced their Thanksgiving meal savings last week.
